# SubFlow AI — Turkish desktop interface community fork

Repository: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/subflow-ai
Upstream original: https://github.com/sadraahkami/subflow-ai
License: MIT, retained from upstream.

## What is included
- Original offline speech-to-text and subtitle studio based on faster-whisper.
- Turkish (tr-TR) GUI messages for 50 interface keys; original Persian and English interfaces remain.
- Three-language switcher: Persian, English, Turkish.
- Five new unit tests for translation coverage and format placeholders.

## Scope / limitations
- The upstream already supported Turkish as a transcription language. This fork adds UI translations only.
- Tested with 16 passing Python unit tests on Windows, including 5 new localization tests.
- No dedicated Windows executable or installer is published by this fork.
- Faster-whisper inference and full graphical integration have not been end-to-end validated for this fork.

Read the README.md, FORK_CHANGES.md, LICENSE and source code before use.
